Definition: Whether a Data Protection Authority or similar body regulates ID data collection and sharing by the ID system
Comments: No data protection authority exists in Libya. The DPI Map records 'National Data Protection Act exists: NO' and no dedicated DPA has been established. The National Information Security and Safety Authority (NISSA), established by Decree No. 28 of 2013, oversees cybersecurity and electronic authentication but is not a data protection authority. Its policies are binding only on the public sector. No independent authority with mandate to oversee personal data processing, receive complaints, or enforce data protection rules has been created.

NISSA (established 2013) oversees ICT security but no published security audit of the identity system exists. Libya scores partially on the NCSI cybersecurity index (60% on strategic indicators) but no ID-specific security review is documented.
